mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that typically leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a disinflationary monetary tightening, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate a soft landing.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the combined signal (FEDFUNDS up and CPIAUCSL down) is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high labor market tightness (measured by UNRATE below 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor demand, which typically leads to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,600,000 units, it signals strong residential construction activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 370,000 million dollars), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points signals increased consumer confidence and higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 370000 and UNRATE declines by >0.1pp.
